population_difference_rationale.definition_phase0_1625: Total size of DEX method_ids table (indexed method references across all bytecode opcodes invoke-virtual, invoke-direct, invoke-static, invoke-interface). Includes internal method definitions and external Android framework/JDK runtime APIs.
population_difference_rationale.definition_phase1a_1061: Total concrete and abstract direct_methods and virtual_methods declared inside class_data_item structures of the 154 defined classes.
population_difference_rationale.difference_564: Imported external methods from Android OS framework (android.*) and Java runtime (java.*) called by application code but not defined in classes.dex.
population_difference_rationale.conclusion: Zero population loss. The 1,625 vs 1,061 difference is an architectural property of Dalvik/ART bytecode specification separating method reference indices from class method declarations.
